title: AW26 Courtyard Walk Reel
caption:
Gold stripes on black, and a camel hoodie set with white sneakers. Two friends cross a sunlit courtyard and AW26 starts walking.

On the left, a black halter mini with a deep V neck, gold bands wrapped around the waist and gold lines running down the skirt. Pointed black heels finish it. Beside her, a camel hoodie with a plush trim around the hood, a front pocket and black drawstrings at the hem. Matching joggers taper to cuffed ankles over clean white sneakers.

One look is dressed for the evening and the other for the weekend, and both come from the same collection.
